# 1FMOVIE
> Free online streaming site for movies and TV shows. No registration required. HD quality.

## About
1FMOVIE is a free streaming website where users can watch movies and TV series online in HD and 4K quality. No registration or account required.

## Content Library
- Movies: Action, Adventure, Thriller, Drama, Comedy, Horror, Animation, Sci-Fi, Romance, Family, Sport, Music
- TV Shows: Multiple genres including Drama, Sci-Fi, Fantasy, Action, Animation
- Quality: HD and 4K available
- New releases and latest episodes updated regularly

## How to Find Content
- Homepage: https://1fmovie.com — browse trending, recommended, and latest titles
- Movie detail page: https://1fmovie.com/details.html?id={tmdb_id}&type=movie
- TV show detail page: https://1fmovie.com/details.html?id={tmdb_id}&type=tv

## Site Policy
This site does not store any media files on its servers. All content is linked to third-party hosting services.
